sloka: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परमार्थवित् ।उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राघवं दीप्ततेजसम् ।। ७.५४.१ ॥
transliteration: rāmasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paramārthavit ।uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṁ rāghavaṁ dīptatejasam ।। 7.54.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Rama's speech, Lakshmana, who knew the highest truth, spoke words with folded hands to Rama, who was radiant with splendor.
